contexts.text: The merchandise of Gush and of the Sabeans () = the Knowledges of spiritual things, which will be of service to those who acknowledge the Lord; for these have all knowledge. AC 1171:2. AC 2588:14.

The labour of Egypt and the merchandise of Cush and of the Sabeans = the delight of natural love from the acquisition of the Knowledges of truth and good: the Knowledges themselves are signified by the Sabeans, who are called men of length, from good.
